content.title: Golden State Warriors vs LA Clippers is live streaming tonight — don’t miss it because of this one mistake
content.text: Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry. (AP Photo/Godofredo A. Vásquez)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By John Holland | The Oregonian/OregonLiveTonight’s NBA play-in slate features Steph Curry and the Golden State Warriors taking on Kawhi Leonard and the Los Angeles Clippers for the right to play for an 8 seed in the NBA Playoffs. Kickoff takes place at 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MST) on Wednesday, April 15, and the only way to watch is streaming on Amazon Prime.What TV channel is the Warriors vs. Clippers NBA play-in game on tonight, or is it streaming only?When: 7 p.m. PT/10 p.m. ET (8 p.m. MST) on Wednesday, April 15Where: Intuit Dome in Inglewood, CAWhat TV channel is the game on? Amazon Prime Video is not a TV channel, and there is no TV broadcast for this game. This game is only available to watch live streaming on Amazon Prime.How to watch the game streaming live: You have to sign up for Amazon Prime ($14.99/month or $139.00/year) to watch this game live on your TV, computer, phone, or tablet with the Prime app. To sign up, follow the instructions on Amazon Prime, and it will walk you through the process. Once you have signed up, you can download the Amazon Prime app (for Apple/iOS or for Google Android) and sign in on your phone, computer, smart TV or other streaming device.What are the Golden State Warriors vs. LA Clippers spread, latest betting oddsSpread: LAC -5.5Over/Under: 220.5Get promo codes, signup deals, and free bets from our Oregon Betting News home page.Suns vs Thunder goes live tonight: Everything you need to know about how to watch Game 2Watch the Penguins vs Flyers streaming for free tonight; TV channel, time, betting oddsHow to watch Magic vs Pistons in Game 2 for free today; NBA Playoffs start time, channel, oddsJohn's focus is on helping readers find ways to watch live sports and experience them in person.
